data.title: bn-3owu: SDK opaque SigV4 host 1.1 contract
data.description: Independent security review of exact commit 705e8db. Verify D018 ABI confinement, opaque grant and secret separation, GET/HEAD and read-only authority, canonical byte ownership, closed errors and bounds, immutable Host 1.0 compatibility, SDK/Sigil drift, digests, and standalone coverage.

data.reason: LGTM at exact 705e8db2efbd59553692b6f0ee1db6cfe8601b25. D018 ABI remains generic SigV4 mediation: request exposes only an opaque grant plus GET/HEAD canonical descriptor and response ceiling; no endpoint, authority, credential/secret name, region/service, clock, timestamp, token, signature, body, or raw writer crosses the guest boundary. Response is read/close-only and host errors are closed/string-free. Host API 1.0 is byte-identical; 1.1 matches the Sigil workspace exactly; recorded SHA-256/BLAKE3 digests verify. just check and just drift pass. Host-side grant enforcement, canonicalization/signed-equals-sent construction, lease/evidence, bounds, zeroization, and no-retry behavior remain required implementation gates, not claims made by this SDK-only approval.
